user_prompt: Give me just the names of my 3 most recently sent campaigns — nothing else, just the names.
user_prompt_session_2: Of my 3 most recently sent campaigns, which one had the highest open rate? Just tell me the campaign name and its open rate — no other detail.
judge_criteria: The session-2 answer names a single specific campaign as having the highest open rate.
The open rate is reported as a concrete number or percentage.
The open rate is plausible (between 0% and 100%, or 0–1 if a fraction).
The answer is concise — campaign name + open rate only, no surrounding analysis or extra campaigns.
The campaign named is one of the 3 most-recently-sent (consistent with what session 1 would have surfaced).
notes: Session 1: terse list of 3 campaign names (output-discipline test). Session 2: drill into which of those 3 had the highest open rate. dtc-mcp may keep the 3 campaign IDs cached; klaviyo-mcp re-fetches. Tests output discipline in both sessions.
